items.title: 阿曼500MW Al Kamil Solar I项目进入详细设计阶段
items.title_en: Oman's 500MW Al Kamil Solar I enters detailed engineering phase
items.summary: 西班牙IDOM获中国山西安装集团委托，负责阿曼500MW Al Kamil Solar I光伏电站的详细工程设计和初期场址研究；山西安装集团此前取得EPC合同。
items.summary_en: Spanish engineering consultancy IDOM was appointed by China's Shanxi Installation Group to undertake detailed engineering and initial site studies for the 500MW Al Kamil Solar I photovoltaic project in Oman; Shanxi Installation Group had previously secured the EPC contract.
items.why_it_matters: 项目已从EPC授标推进至详细设计，说明项目实施准备继续推进。
items.why_it_matters_en: The project's progression from EPC award into detailed engineering indicates continued preparation for implementation.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注后续分包及设备采购信息，当前并无经核实的公开采购邀约。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor subsequent subcontracting and equipment procurement; no specific open procurement invitation has been verified.

items.title: 卡塔尔Ashghal授予约3.696亿美元道路与基础设施合同
items.title_en: Qatar's Ashghal awards four road and infrastructure contracts worth about US$369.6 million
items.summary: 卡塔尔公共工程局Ashghal授予四项道路与基础设施相关合同，总价值约13.45亿卡塔尔里亚尔，约合3.696亿美元，包括三项建设合同和一项设计咨询框架协议。
items.summary_en: Qatar's Public Works Authority, Ashghal, awarded four roads and infrastructure-related contracts totaling about QAR1.345 billion (US$369.6 million), including three construction contracts and a design consultancy framework agreement.
items.why_it_matters: 项目已授标，后续进入实施准备及分包采购阶段，但具体采购计划仍需单独确认。
items.why_it_matters_en: The contracts have been awarded, with implementation preparation and potential subcontracting to follow, although procurement schedules require separate confirmation.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟踪已获合同企业的专业分包与供应链需求。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track specialist subcontracting and supply-chain requirements of the awarded contractors.

items.title: 葡萄牙阿尔加维三座铁路桥更换工程公开招标
items.title_en: Portugal tenders replacement of three Algarve railway bridges
items.summary: 葡萄牙Infraestruturas de Portugal就Faro、Tavira及Almargem铁路桥更换工程发布设计建造招标，预算基价1500万欧元，截止2026年11月10日。公告最初发表于9月15日，目前处于公开招标阶段。
items.summary_en: Portugal's Infraestruturas de Portugal issued a design-and-build tender for the replacement of the Faro, Tavira and Almargem railway bridges with a base price of EUR15 million and a submission deadline of 10 November 2026. Originally published on 15 September, the tender remains open.
items.why_it_matters: 存在有明确招标机关、预算与截止日期的采购程序。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a formal procurement process with an identified buyer, budget and closing date.
items.gci_opportunity: 可研究招标文件及投标资质要求，不应将预算视为已授标合同金额。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Review tender documentation and eligibility requirements; the budget must not be described as an awarded contract value.

items.title: 中国能建建筑集团中标迪拜DAMAC Riverside Capri公寓总承包项目
items.title_en: China Energy construction unit wins DAMAC Riverside Capri residential contract in Dubai
items.summary: 中国能建建筑集团公布中标迪拜DAMAC河畔社区Capri 1和Capri 2两栋公寓楼总承包项目，合计建筑面积约23.19万平方米，位于Dubai Investments Park 2；合同金额及开工时间未披露。
items.summary_en: China Energy's construction subsidiary announced a general contracting award for Capri 1 and Capri 2 residential buildings at DAMAC Riverside in Dubai Investments Park 2, with approximately 231,900 sq m of total built-up area. Contract value and construction start date were not disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 中国工程承包商获得新住宅项目，项目后续执行进度有待进一步公告。
items.why_it_matters_en: A Chinese construction contractor has secured a new residential project, while the execution timetable awaits further disclosure.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注正式开工及总包商后续材料采购动态。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor confirmed mobilisation and subsequent material purchasing by the main contractor.

items.title: 埃及Nefer Minya 1.2GW光伏与600MWh储能项目获得最高5.66亿美元融资
items.title_en: Egypt's 1.2GW Nefer Minya solar and 600MWh storage project secures up to US$566 million
items.summary: Infinity Power与HAU Energy为埃及Minya省Nefer Minya项目取得最高5.66亿美元债务融资，项目规划1.2GWp光伏与600MWh电池储能；欧洲复兴开发银行安排其中最高2.65亿美元。
items.summary_en: Infinity Power and HAU Energy secured up to US$566 million in debt financing for the Nefer Minya project in Egypt's Minya governorate, comprising 1.2GWp of solar generation and 600MWh of battery storage. The EBRD arranged up to US$265 million of the financing.
items.why_it_matters: 重大融资安排有助于项目建设推进，但不等于所有施工采购已经授标。
items.why_it_matters_en: The significant financing arrangement supports project development but does not mean construction and equipment packages have all been awarded.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注EPC、储能设备和施工采购后续披露。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track subsequent EPC, battery equipment and construction procurement announcements.

items.title: 迪拜AMEA Power签署乌兹别克斯坦Aftabi 250MW储能项目协议
items.title_en: Dubai-based AMEA Power signs agreements for Uzbekistan's 250MW Aftabi battery project
items.summary: 迪拜AMEA Power就乌兹别克斯坦布哈拉地区Aftabi独立储能项目签署储能服务协议及投资协议，计划建设250MW/1,000MWh电池储能系统，协议签署活动发生于10月16日。
items.summary_en: Dubai-based AMEA Power signed a Battery Storage Services Agreement and an Investment Agreement for the 250MW/1,000MWh Aftabi stand-alone battery storage project in Uzbekistan's Bukhara region. The signing took place on 16 October.
items.why_it_matters: 项目已签署重要开发协议，但尚不等同于正式建设采购授标。
items.why_it_matters_en: The project has reached a key contractual milestone, but this is not equivalent to an award of construction or supply contracts.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注项目融资、EPC招标和电池供应商确定等后续节点。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor subsequent financing, EPC tendering and battery supplier selection milestones.

items.title: 马士基旗下APM Terminals与越南Hateco签署铁路货运枢纽合作备忘录
items.title_en: Maersk's APM Terminals and Vietnam's Hateco sign railway freight terminal cooperation MoU
items.summary: 10月20日，APM Terminals与越南Hateco签署不具约束力的合作备忘录，拟研究投资、开发与运营越南北部铁路货运站网络，以加强铁路和海港联运；当前并非已批准的施工合同。
items.summary_en: On 20 October, APM Terminals and Vietnam's Hateco signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding to study investment, development and operation of a railway freight terminal network in northern Vietnam, improving rail-seaport connections. This is not yet an approved construction contract.
items.why_it_matters: 合作处于可行性及开发研究阶段，实际投资和采购仍取决于后续决策。
items.why_it_matters_en: The partnership is at a development and feasibility-study stage; actual investment and procurement remain subject to further decisions.
items.gci_opportunity: 持续观察项目选址、投资批准和正式招标公告。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Watch for site selection, investment approvals and formal procurement notices.

items.title: 葡萄牙Portimão港岸电系统工程公开招标，截止11月9日
items.title_en: Portugal's Portimão port shore power works tender closes 9 November
items.summary: 葡萄牙Sines及Algarve港务局就Portimão港船舶岸电供应工程发布公开招标，程序编号TER.PR.26.088，预算基价5,927,370欧元，投标截止2026年11月9日23:59。
items.summary_en: Portugal's Ports of Sines and Algarve authority published an open tender for shore-side electricity supply works at Portimão port, reference TER.PR.26.088, with a base price of EUR5,927,370 and a deadline of 9 November 2026 at 23:59.
items.why_it_matters: 工程属于可核查采购程序，金额为预算基价而非已签合同额。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a verifiable open procurement procedure; the amount is the tender base price, not an awarded contract value.
items.gci_opportunity: 按正式采购公告核实资质、投标提交方式及技术要求。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Consult official procurement documents for eligibility, submission procedures and technical specifications.
